name: permission-heavy

quietSegments.note: The migration permission request waits 195 seconds before the grant arrives and work resumes.

summary: Scripted session posted through the live daemon pipeline (POST /events with the codex header into a hearable record daemon): three permission prompts, the third waiting 195 seconds before it is granted. Live Codex capture was impossible because the account usage limit blocked every model turn, so the scenario is invented and labelled synthetic.
